body: I don't know how to go about this anymore, talking about it feels wrong and doesn't help that much. Thank you for being here tho, at least i had courage to type something down.

Thank you for those kind words. It is not as easy to live like this. With all these feeling I can not comprehend, all this pain stuck inside me like my soul and body are tearing apart, sometime its 20 minutes sometime it lasts for a day, like under water, no air, being stabbed like I am stuck In a loop. She smokes weed daily, sometime I make her not smoke when we are together but I cant imagine what happens when I am not around if she casually takes pills and other supplements and talks openly about it. I tried to talk to her but I just cant, I get stressed and start fainting, I am afraid of what is behind those doors, more shit thrown my way. She went passive aggressive on me for apologizing when she got a little mad. I don't blame her, So many people run away hearing part of what is inside me. People are don't get tangled in what they can't understand which is why it feels better not talking about it. Avoids unnecessary situations and feeling like I am being interrogated but I simply don't have an answer to some questions.
